title: The phase-4 checker's passage judgments run on the model census.STEP_MODELS names, or the docs stop saying so
goal: Either a census.py command runs the passage judgments of sample --brief on census.STEP_MODELS['check'] and the kb-census skill's phase 4 uses it, or the brief header, kb/_self/web-sources.md and kb/_self/token-efficiency.md stop saying the checker runs on Haiku 5.5.

run:
import sys
s=open('_tools/census.py',encoding='utf-8').read();n=s.count('STEP_MODELS["check"]')+s.count("STEP_MODELS['check']")
r=lambda p:' '.join(open(p,encoding='utf-8').read().split())
say="STEP_MODELS['check']`, Haiku" in r('kb/_self/web-sources.md') or "checker's passage judgments run on Haiku" in r('kb/_self/token-efficiency.md')
print(n,say);sys.exit(0 if n>1 or not say else 1)
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import census; m = census.STEP_MODELS["check"]; print(m); sys.exit(0 if isinstance(m, str) and m.startswith("claude-") else 1)
